Name: In a Heartbeat - early dating and marriage
Author: Shockah
Description:
[size=6]TL;DR:[/size]
[size=4]Show some extra love to date/marry villagers early. Adds craftable Bouquets and Mermaid's Pendants.[/size]

Adds an option to craft a Bouquet and/or a Mermaid's Pendant via an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14451]advanced interaction[/url] with Caroline.

To arrange a Bouquet, you need to prepare at least 5 flowers, of at least 2 different types or colors. If all of the flowers are of a higher quality, so will the resulting Bouquet - for example, if all 5 flowers are at least gold quality, the Bouquet will also be of gold quality. The higher the Bouquet quality, the earlier you can start dating a villager, reducing by 1 heart for each quality. An iridium quality Bouquet allows you to start dating at 5 hearts of friendship.
The mod will automatically use the highest possible quality flowers that will still make a bouquet of the highest possible quality, while also taking into account the flower sell prices (using the cheapest ones).

To craft a Mermaid's Pendant, you need to prepare a Pearl and 2-8 different gems (out of Emerald, Aquamarine, Ruby, Amethyst, Topaz, Jade, Diamond and Prismatic Shard). 2 gems make a regular quality Mermaid's Pendant, 4 make a silver quality, 6 make a gold quality and all 8 make an iridium quality. The higher the Mermaid's Pendant quality, the earlier you can marry a villager, reducing by 1 heart for each quality. An iridium quality Mermaid's Pendant allows you to marry a villager at 7 hearts of friendship.

[size=6]Configuration[/size]
The mod has [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] support. You can also edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=6]Other info[/size]
You can find the source code [url=https://github.com/Shockah/Stardew-Valley-Mods/tree/master/InAHeartbeat]here[/url].
